Welcome to my website. I am a Postdoctoral Scholar in the [Department of Economics](https://as.tufts.edu/economics) at [Tufts University](https://www.tufts.edu).

I work on topics in **economics of education**, **applied microeconomics**, and **development economics**. My research focuses on how early-life policies like school-entry affirmative action and universal pre-K shape children's educational trajectories.
